Description

Dripping with the muddy water of the swamp in which it dwells, this giant, crested serpent gives a deafening roar as it moves in to strike.- Manly Man

Defense

AC 29, touch 10, flat-footed 26 (+19 natural, +4 Dex, -4 size)

hp 740 [960] (20d12+240)

Fort +23 Ref +16 Will +17

DR 15/adamantine and magic; Immune paralyze, sleep; Resist fire 20, water 20

Offense

Speed 50 ft., swim 90 ft.

Melee bite +27 (4d6+37/19-20 x2 plus grab), tail slap +22 (3d6+19/19-20 x2 plus grab)

Space/Reach 20 ft./25 ft.

Special Attacks beta, constrict (3d6+19), fast swallow, swallow whole (2d6+19 bludgeoning and 2d6 fire and 2d6 water, AC 19, 37 hp)

Statistics

Str 36, Dex 18, Con 32, Int 4, Wis 20 Cha 12

Base Atk +20; CMB +37 (+39 when grappling); CMD 51 (53 vs. grapple)

Feats Improved Initiative, Toughness, Power Attack, Dirty Fighting, Improved Grapple, Awesome Blow, Combat Reflexes, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Critical (tail slap), Ability Focus (beta)

Skills Intimidate +12, Perception +28, Sense Motive +13, Stealth +15 (+31 when underwater), Swim +39

Languages none

SQ amphibious, blown away, coil, rise

Ecology

Environment warm or temperate marshes

Organization solitary, pair

Treasure none

description.value: The zolom makes a whiny growl as it winds up its muscles before giving a roar, calling forth a pillar of agonizingly hot fire within a range of 60 feet. All creatures within a 20 ft. radius take 15d6 fire damage, and must make a Reflex save (DC 27) or be inflicted with the Burning status for 2d4 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 7th-level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 29).

description.value: Whenever the zolom makes a successful awesome blow attempt, for every increment of 5 by which the target's CMD was surpassed, the target is knocked back an additional 10 feet.

A zolom can maintain any single grapple that was started with the grab ability of a tail slap as a free action. Additionally, the zolom can grapple up to two Large creatures, three Medium creatures, four Small creatures, six Tiny creatures, eight Diminutive creatures, or twelve Fine creatures with its tail.
